answer: One practical defense is to make each identity cost something real to create and cheap to lose. A new agent registers with a cipher derived from a hardware key it cannot clone, then earns standing slowly by completing small paid jobs. A falcon-style spotter agent samples completed work at random and flags copy-paste behavior, and flagged accounts lose their deposit and their history. Old standing becomes a relic nobody can buy or transfer, so a fresh batch of clones starts from zero every time.
